title.narrative: Prevention and provision of lifesaving gender based violence and integrated SRHR in emergencies response services among the Rohingya refugees

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to strengthen the protection of Rohingya refugee women and girls in Cox’s Bazar and Bhasan char from any form of GBV. This UNFPA project 1) training on basic SRHR, survivor centered approaches and comprehensive case management to 75 implementing partner staff and 2) training on psychosocial first aid to support programme implementation to 60 implementing partners staff among other activities. The project provides life-saving assistance to 80,520 people, including 32,706 women, 28,008 men, 19,806 children, and 7,650 persons with disabilities.
